environment.home: verify/arc-live-rc7 (isolated; ARC removed from the web profile before this run)

projectionsUnderBasic.interpretation: the surface stays in its compacted shape — the 19 shadowed originals remain behind the checkpoint in the append-only log and are NOT projected. An originals flood would project every event (hundreds of K tokens)

resumedTurn.prompt: no-tool question about reference notes plus whether the early turns are visible in full or as a compressed block
modelObserved: the compressed block structure (reports the summary node, not the originals)
the live villa-inventory note verbatim (uncompressed content survives untouched)
correctly refused to fabricate a 'Meridian' note that was never actually sent (test-prompt error caught by the model)

whyItHolds: surface replacement is an official session-log event vocabulary (surfaceOp on compaction events, the same protocol compaction-basic itself writes). The host's deriveMessages projection honors it regardless of which backend — or none — is installed. ARC owns no in-memory surface, so removing ARC cannot resurrect the originals.
